strongest_counterhypothesis: Standard Poincare/Floquet/transverse-contraction or small-gain analysis, invoked as ordinary Harness diagnostics and consumed by the existing Frank loop controller, gives the same useful stability information with less architecture and no new runtime organ.
kill_rule: If conventional diagnostics plus existing typed receipts match real-target defect detection, perturbation localization, replay reproducibility and controller integration with less complexity, delete the TRSE named object and retain only the test obligation.
reopen_only_if: Real Frank evidence shows a typed phase-aligned perturbation envelope materially improves fault detection, calibration, cost, or lesion localization over the smallest conventional implementation.
synthetic_discriminator_relation: The synthetic counterexamples establish insufficiency of scalar/local heuristics for the constructed systems. They do not establish uniqueness of TRSE because conventional full-return/transverse methods solve the same constructed distinction.
